turn.context: Playbook §4, part 1 at the level of the answer: what the automations do, briefly, on this hospital's real times. The detail of how they work is for Automations.

text: Automations are the part that puts the unused night hours to work.
bullets: The decision is already made on the evening round. Today nothing moves until the morning signature.
Your staff write the same facts twice. Once in the notes, then again in the summary and the bill.
An early insurance request stops the insurer from setting the time a patient leaves.
chat.pointer: Switch between Today and With the automations to see the knot come undone. Pick a thread for its detail.
chat.invite: Next is the changes on the wards. This part leans on them.
chat.note: The work is not slow. It just waits all night.
prompts: Our doctors don’t use voice notes
What does our IT team have to do?
Next, the changes on the wards

moves.prompt: What does our IT team have to do?

blocks.title: The knot that forms overnight
blocks.deck: Five threads of going-home work, drawn on your real times. Today they wait all night, then knot at the morning signature.

captions.today: Every thread waits for the morning signature. The patient leaves at about 3:15 PM.
captions.with: Each thread starts on the evening round. Only the final checks wait for the morning.

threads.name: Discharge summary
threads.today: Typed the next morning, from the doctor’s notes
threads.with: Drafted on the round, then signed that night
threads.tojo_does: Drafts the summary from notes already in your files
threads.needs: Your IT team lets Tojo read your records

threads.name: Final bill
threads.with: Kept up to date through the stay, final first thing
threads.tojo_does: Adds each charge to the bill as it happens
threads.removes: The count of supplies before billing
threads.needs: Billing agrees to check, not build, the bill

threads.name: Insurance approval
threads.today: Asked for only once the bill is final
threads.with: An early request goes the evening before
threads.tojo_does: Sends an early request with the expected bill
threads.removes: Waiting for the final bill to ask
threads.needs: Your insurers accept an early request

threads.name: Medicines to take home
threads.today: Listed after the signature, then packed
threads.with: Listed on the round, packed before the morning
threads.tojo_does: Sends the pharmacy the list that evening
threads.removes: The pharmacy rush after the signature
threads.needs: The pharmacy sees the list at night

threads.name: Family and transport
threads.today: Called in the morning, arrive in the afternoon
threads.with: Told the same evening, transport booked
threads.tojo_does: Sends the family a message with a likely time
threads.removes: Families arriving late in the day
threads.needs: A phone number for each family

blocks.condition: The green times are goals. Other hospitals saved 6 to 8 hours a discharge. Not yet measured here.
